# Handoff Acknowledged

## Status Summary

| Metric | Champion | Last PASS |
|--------|----------|-----------|
| Tuning Mean | **1.904** | 1.762 |
| Tuning Min | **0.431** | 0.051 ⚠️ |
| Lockbox Mean | 1.793 | **1.793** |
| Lockbox Min | 1.134 | **1.347** |
| Worst MDD | **-9.3%** | -11.2% |

## Key Observations

1. **Champion holds** - Better tuning stability and drawdown profile
2. **Candidate concern** - Tuning min of 0.051 indicates near-flat performance in at least one fold; risky despite marginally better lockbox minimum
3. **System healthy** - 206 loops in 22h, ~3.2 iterations/hour

## Recommendations

The next commands are appropriate. Before running:

```bash
# Verify no stale locks
ls -la baseline/*.lock 2>/dev/null

# Check disk space (206 iterations generates artifacts)
df -h .
```

Then proceed with provided commands:
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

## Watch Items
- Monitor for candidates with tuning_min > 0.3 (stability threshold)
- Fold14 appears to be the challenging fold—may warrant targeted analysis if pattern persists

Ready to continue runloop. 🟢
